segments.name: Universal Electronics Inc.
segments.description: Designs, develops and manufactures home entertainment control, climate control, smart home and audio-video products for leading global brands.
segments.evidence: We design, develop, manufacture, ship and support home entertainment control products, technology and software solutions, climate control solutions, wireless sensor and smart home control products and audio-video ("AV") accessories, that are used by the world's leading brands in the home entertainment, climate control, consumer electronics, security, home automation and home appliance markets.

revenueModel.text: OEMs, video service providers, utilities and retailers purchase remote controls, thermostats, sensors, software licenses and accessories.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute remote control devices, connected thermostats, integrated circuits ("ICs"), home security sensors and AV accessories directly to video and security service providers and OEMs, both domestically and internationally.
